items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Billy VerPlanck, I asked them to write new arrangements to put the Miller style, which they did.

ctx.x: In fact, many times I got a hold of Bill Finegan again and asked him to write a couple new arrangements and different people that I liked, Billy VerPlanck, I asked them to write new arrangements to put the Miller style, which they did. And sometimes when I would play these songs somebody would pass by and say, “I don’t remember that” and I would say, “Well, that’s a song that we found in the archives.”
